subject: Request: dataflow diagram + no-train evidence for DPA redlines
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@novushealth.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: dataflow diagram + no-train evidence for DPA redlines

Hi Aisha,

Thanks for the productive call yesterday. As we prepare the DPA redlines for internal review, Novus asked for two pieces we need to confirm on our side so Legal and Security can sign off:

1) A clear dataflow diagram that shows exactly what flows to Redwood, which subprocessors handle persistent storage, and which components (if any) touch unredacted customer prompts.
2) Evidence that you’ll accept our no-training / no-model-improvement commitment in the DPA (scope and timeline) and any export/residency constraints tied to SFTP or dedicated export paths.

Can you attach a diagram and any existing evidence matrix? If you have a canonical list of approved subprocessors (including region/residency), that will speed review. We aim to get to legal sign-off by Friday 23 Apr; if you can share the artifacts by EOD Wed 20 Apr that would be very helpful.

Attachments we can provide from our side: a first-pass redline (dpa_redline_marcus_v1.docx) and a short evidence template we use for customers (novus_evidence_matrix.xlsx). I’ll also share a Drive folder after this email.

If it helps, we can schedule a 30-min ops call to walk through the flow.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

--
Redwood Inference | Developer-first inference platform

From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@novushealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Reilly <tom.reilly@novushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 11:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: dataflow diagram + no-train evidence for DPA redlines

Marcus,

Thanks — attaching our internal dataflow (novus_dataflow_v1.pdf) and a short subprocessors list. A few clarifications upfront:

- Novus requires the vendor (Redwood) to commit to no-model-improvement on customer prompts where explicitly excluded by contract. We can accept Redwood’s standard "no-train" language if there is an auditable enforcement path (logs, retention policy, and subprocessor guarantees).
- We prefer SFTP transfer for exports; please confirm if Redwood supports a nightly SFTP export to our EU-residency bucket or if you require a different pattern.
- Subprocessor list below includes the infra provider (CloudCo US-West), analytics provider (InsightOps), and a third-party logging vendor. We expect any additional subprocessors to be disclosed 30 days prior to onboarding.

Attached: novus_dataflow_v1.pdf (diagram), novus_subprocessors_list.csv (inline in PDF).

We can meet tomorrow 20 Apr 10:00-10:30 PT to walk through the diagram if you’re available.

Regards,
Aisha Khan
Senior Director, Procurement & Vendor Risk | Novus Health
aisha.khan@novushealth.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@novushealth.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: dataflow diagram + no-train evidence for DPA redlines

Aisha — thanks for the quick turnaround and the diagram. A few notes from our side after a quick pass:

- SFTP exports: Redwood supports both push and pull SFTP models and can route exports to EU-residency buckets. We can run an initial config in a staging folder to confirm checksum/format.
- Subprocessors: current set we use for Hosted customers is: CloudCo US-West (compute/storage), LogStream (log aggregation), MetricsHub (observability), and SafeKey (KMS provider). We’ll attach a published subprocessors matrix to the Drive folder.
- Evidence for no-train: we can provide a short attestation, retention config, and a redacted logs sample showing prompt non-retention for exclusion-scoped customers. Rachel (legal) and Dev (ops) are looped for specifics.

We’ve uploaded our redline (dpa_redline_marcus_v1.docx) and the evidence template (novus_evidence_matrix.xlsx) here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExampleDataflow

I’ll bring a proposed clause here for quick read: "Vendor will not use customer prompts or responses for model training, improvement, or evaluation except pursuant to a separate written agreement. Vendor shall provide attestation and support evidence within 10 business days of request." Please flag language you cannot accept.

I’ll be on the 10:00 PT call tomorrow.

Best,
Marcus

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@novushealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: dataflow diagram + no-train evidence for DPA redlines

Aisha,

Appreciate the diagram and subprocessors list. I reviewed Marcus’ proposed clause and attached a redline with two asks:

1) Define the operational evidence scope — what logs and samples will be provided and the turnaround time (we propose 10 business days).
2) Add a subprocessor certification requirement: any subprocessors that process excluded prompts must provide a written attestation that they will not use that data for model improvement and must support audit evidence on request.

I’m attaching the redline (dpa_redline_marcus_v1.docx) with inline notes. If Novus can sign to the proposed operational evidence and confirmation on subprocessor certification, we can accept the no-train commitment and prepare a DocuSign for the DPA amendment.

One practical note for Dev/ops: please confirm if the attestation can be automated or if we need additional legal paperwork per subprocessor.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com

From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@novushealth.com>

Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: dataflow diagram + no-train evidence for DPA redlines

Rachel / Marcus,

Thanks for the redline and the proposed evidence scope. Novus can accept the 10-business-day attestation turnaround and requires the subprocessor certification clause as redlined. We have a short DocuSign ready for the amendment — please confirm the final redline and we’ll route to our legal.

For Ops (Dev/Laura): confirm SFTP export details and a staging schedule for a test export next week (we prefer 04/26 for a proof run). Once Novus receives the test export and verifies residency/format, legal will finalize.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abc123-example

Aisha Khan
Senior Director, Procurement & Vendor Risk | Novus Health
